proof_groups.grouping_reason: Both witnesses are the two directions of the same circular-DLL focus transformation over prefix ++ node :: suffix: decompose xizi_dll into the forward/reverse shift predicates, then reclose those predicates after bypassing the focused node. Keeping both witnesses together lets one worker prove and reuse the same induction pattern and helper family; the group has 2 witnesses, below the limit of 12.
proof_groups.proof_strategy: For the entail witness choose the left disjunct, introduce head/prefix/node/suffix, and apply a case-lib helper proved by induction on prefix (with suffix recursion at the focus) that exposes predecessor and successor plus the four boundary fields. For the return witness choose the left disjunct, frame the two self-link fields of the removed node, fold them with xizi_dll_empty_rev, and apply the inverse reclose helper to the shifted prefix/suffix and rewired predecessor/successor boundary fields.
